messages:
olivia: Heads up 1 p95 spike on latency dashboard for /v2/infer after yesterday's routing tweak. p50 steady, p99 flat. anyone else seeing this?
rahul: saw it in eu-west around 18:30 UTC. p95 went 120ms -> 300ms for ~10% traffic slice.
sasha: are retries included in the metric? the routing change introduced fallback to cpu-quantized variant.
olivia: dashboard label says 'endpoint latency (server_time)'. unclear if retries/transport are included.
marc: ingestion path note: service emits service_time; gateway emits transport+retry. Rollup currently merges event types and may lose provenance. mixing clocks can distort p50/p95.
kevin: can you paste the query? want to repro.
olivia: snippet: `service:api.backend endpoint:/v2/infer | by route,region | p95(1000ms) over 5m` against last 24h.
rahul: deploy-bot shows the rollout: `deploy-bot: routing.weight change 2026-03-18T18:15 prefer-low-cost-region 0.9 -> fallback quantized-cpu`
sasha: fallback adds an extra proxy hop + kv-cache miss risk. that would shift p95 if many fallbacks. p99 unchanged if rare.
marc: proposal: surface a provenance tag in metrics (service|gateway|retry|kvcache) and avoid blind merges.
kevin: short-term: console toggle to exclude retries; add `?include_retries=false` to telemetry API.
olivia: UX ask: minimal toggles. I'd like two small options: 'exclude retries' and 'split cache-hit vs miss'.
rahul: ingestion strips internal flags for privacy. I'll add hashed provenance labels (kvcache|retry|primary) so no internal names leak.
sasha: test scenarios: simulate 90% fast route A + 10% slow fallback B, then weight flip to 50/50 to validate quantile behavior.
marc: also document whether percentiles include transport and retries; current docs ambiguous.
kevin: long-term: provenance badges on percentile tiles + split sparkline (hit vs miss). I'll wire toggle this afternoon.
olivia: action items: rahul telemetry PR, olivia mock, kevin console stub, sasha tests, marc review quantile merge logic.
deploy-bot: note: rollback scheduled if p95 > 250ms for 30m in prod.
olivia: i'll coordinate with oncall if it persists. thanks team :thumbsup:
